result:
All tests now pass! 

**The bug:** In `tally/invoice.py` line 42, the discount condition was using `>` instead of `>=`.

```python
# Before (wrong)
if self.units() > BULK_UNITS:  # Only applies discount when units > 10

# After (fixed)  
if self.units() >= BULK_UNITS:  # Applies discount when units >= 10
```

The test "bulk_discount_starts_at_ten_units" expects a 5% discount to apply at exactly 10 units, but the code was only applying it when units exceeded 10. With 10 units, the discount was incorrectly 0 instead of 80.
